why.stone: The gentlest slant keeps the figures and capitals planted and monumental, the closest to carved stone.
why.carving: Facets crisp and coherent, digits very clear; the oblique barely distinguishes the carving from the upright.
why.calm: Very steady and composed, with full presence and no restlessness.
why.personality: So close to upright that the oblique has little voice of its own.
why.oblique: Even, undistorted slant with steady spacing, but so slight that it reads almost as a sloped upright.

why.stone: Gentlest slant keeps the carved weight fully grounded; Bench press and 62.5 feel like inscription.
why.carving: Clean, coherent carving with clear digits; facets are calm rather than showy.
why.calm: The most steady and composed of the four while retaining presence.
why.personality: Deliberate and quiet, though the restraint makes it slightly less memorable.
why.oblique: Even, unhurried slant that sits closest to the upright, though at small sizes the contrast with upright is a little soft.

why.stone: The shallowest lean keeps the display most grounded and monumental, still faceted.
why.carving: Clean, crisp facets with clear digits; slightly softer than K3.
why.calm: The steadiest of the four, with quiet confidence and no restlessness.
why.personality: The gentle slant drifts toward the upright, so the oblique voice is the least distinct.
why.oblique: Even, undistorted slant, though it is so mild that it sits almost too close to the upright.

why.stone: Moderate slant keeps the faceted wedge terminals and heavy figures reading as cut stone, only slightly lighter in feel than the upright.
why.carving: Facets on B, p, 6, 2 and 5 are coherent and crisp and the digits are clear, though the kg and x sit a little loosely beside the figures.
why.calm: Measured slant gives a steady forward lean without urgency, with real presence in the title.
why.personality: A recognisable chiselled sloped roman, though it sits close to K2 and K4 in voice.
why.oblique: Even, deliberate angle with steady strokes and spacing; sits comfortably beside the upright with no visible distortion.

why.stone: Moderate slant keeps the carved masses grounded; Bench press and 62.5 still read as cut stone.
why.carving: Facets are coherent and crisp, digits clear, with the 6 and 2 well formed; nothing distinctive beyond solid.
why.calm: Steady mid slant with presence, no restlessness.
why.personality: Recognisable carved voice but hard to tell apart from K2.
why.oblique: Even slant and spacing, sits well beside the upright; capitals slightly lean-heavy but not distorted.

why.stone: Faceted bowls and wedge serifs keep the slanted display reading as cut stone with a firm baseline.
why.carving: Facets are coherent and crisp across Bench press and the digits, and 6, 2 and 5 stay clear, though the 6 bowl is slightly lumpy.
why.calm: A moderate slant gives forward motion without agitation; steady presence.
why.personality: A recognisable chiselled italic voice, though very close to K2.
why.oblique: Even, moderate slant with steady strokes that sits well beside the upright; no visible distortion.

why.stone: Still reads as carved, though the slightly steeper lean begins to loosen the grounded block feel of the figures.
why.carving: Facets stay clean and digits clear; the 6 and 5 hold their cut forms well at the stronger angle.
why.calm: A touch more forward motion than K1; steady but a little more pressing.
why.personality: Slightly more energetic voice than K1, but hard to tell apart from it at a glance.
why.oblique: Consistent angle and spacing with no lopsided letters, a fraction more mechanical-looking in the capitals than K1.

why.stone: Nearly identical to K1, a touch more slant but still grounded carving.
why.carving: Crisp coherent facets; digits clear and sturdy.
why.calm: Steady and composed, marginally more forward motion than K1.
why.personality: Same carved voice as K1, deliberate but not further distinguished.
why.oblique: Even deliberate slant with steady strokes; pairs well with the upright.

why.stone: Practically identical to K1: faceted, grounded, stony at display size.
why.carving: Crisp, coherent facets and clear digits, with marginally sharper corners on the 5 and 6 than K1.
why.calm: Steady moderate slant, calm with presence.
why.personality: The same deliberate chiselled voice as K1; hard to tell apart.
why.oblique: Even slant and steady spacing, comfortable next to the upright.
